gifts.title: An order-ticket checklist built for Spicy Pie's own build-your-own menu
gifts.for_complaint: Order/delivery mistakes — wrong, missing, forgotten, or refused orders
gifts.deliverable: A printable half-page slip (PDF/HTML, print at any printer today) staffers check off per order: slice vs whole, sauce (regular or spicy marinara), extra toppings side (half/whole), GF crust flag, delivery vs pickup vs dine-in, and a forgotten-order safeguard line for phone/delivery tickets. Built around their actual by-the-slice/half-topping system, not a generic order form.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their current menu structure and topping/sauce options — reachable today at their live site https://pizzagrindersbeer.com/ (200 OK) — no login needed.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Every wrong-order complaint in the review pile traces to the same failure point: half-toppings, sauce swaps, and delivery hand-off aren't tracked anywhere on paper. A slip shaped to their exact ordering quirks (not a generic ticket) fixes the thing customers are actually naming, for the cost of a print job.

gifts.title: A plain-language gift card and rewards rules card for the counter
gifts.for_complaint: Gift card, punch card, coupon, or rewards-text not honored
gifts.deliverable: A one-page printed card/sign for the register stating, in plain language, what North Dakota law actually requires for gift card expiration and how their rewards/coupon redemptions work — so staff have something to point to instead of improvising an answer customers dispute.
gifts.inputs_needed: North Dakota's public gift-card/store-value statute text (freely available via the ND Century Code online, no login) plus the name of their existing loyalty program as customers describe it in reviews ('the club', rewards app, punch cards).
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Two customers on record say a denied card or coupon cost the business their whole family's future visits. This directly answers the exact dispute quoted — wrong law cited, no printed policy to check against — with something that ends the argument before it starts.

gifts.title: A spice-level and gluten-free guide naming their actual menu items
gifts.for_complaint: Unmet requests: bring back off-menu items, later hours, allergen clarity, student discount
gifts.deliverable: A one-page guide (posted by the phone/register) listing which named items are GF-crust compatible, which sauces are spicy vs regular, and flags the off-menu Inferno Grinder as available on request — built entirely from their own listed menu, not generic allergen boilerplate.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their current menu and GF crust description, reachable today at https://pizzagrindersbeer.com/. Exact kitchen cross-contamination protocol (fryer sharing, etc.) is not public and would need the owner to fill in one blank line themselves.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: A traveling customer with a food intolerance got 'tell her we don't know' on the phone and left a 1-star review naming the staffer's exact words. A guide with their real items on it means the next call gets a real answer instead of a shrug.
